target.title: fix(ui): keep failed autonomous tool turns visible
target.body:
Closes #97849

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing Control UI or WebChat sessions could see a failed cron, scheduled, or autonomous agent turn rendered as successful when a later adjacent agent turn produced an assistant reply with no user message between the two turns.

The existing open PR #97873 does not block this narrower replacement: it is currently broad/conflicting and carries unrelated dependency, workflow, release, mobile, docs, and extension changes. This PR rebuilds only the shared chat-item projection fix on current `upstream/main`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared tool-turn outcome annotation now treats retained empty assistant groups with a sender label as a turn boundary, so a later autonomous turn's reply cannot mark an earlier failed tool group as succeeded. The boundary is deliberately narrower than "any assistant group without text" so non-text assistant content, such as canvas previews, does not split a normal recovered tool-use turn.

## User Impact

Failed cron, scheduled, and autonomous turns keep their visible tool-error state instead of being silently collapsed as if they succeeded. Existing same-turn behavior is preserved when a failed internal tool is followed by a clean assistant reply in that same turn.

## Evidence

- Current head under review: `868e83a03f92dadbb4d5d32d72af1a2fd178058a`.
- Claim proved: a real stored session transcript with adjacent autonomous turns is read through the Gateway transcript reader/projection path and then grouped by the Control UI chat-item projection without leaking a later assistant reply backward into the earlier failed tool turn.
- Stored transcript proof artifact: https://gist.github.com/qingminglong/1059d1db6c6f25bb9255dbc4cc967141
- Command: `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH="C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" node --import tsx .artifacts/control-ui-e2e/pr-98888-real-transcript-proof/stored-transcript-proof.mjs`
- Path exercised:
  - Wrote a real session JSONL fixture under a temporary OpenClaw state directory.
  - Read it through `src/gateway/session-transcript-readers.ts`.
  - Projected it through `src/gateway/chat-display-projection.ts`.
  - Grouped/render-checked it through Control UI `buildChatItems` with Chromium/Playwright.
- Observed result:
  - `ok=true`, `browserOk=true`
  - `rawMessageCount=4`, `projectedMessageCount=4`, `groupCount=4`
  - `toolErrorCount=1`, `toolOutputCount=1`, `errorBadgeCount=1`
  - `assistantReplyVisible=true`, `emptySenderBoundaryVisible=true`
  - First tool group: `Tool error`, `turnSucceeded=false`
  - Empty sender-labeled boundary: `senderLabel=cron-turn-1`
  - Later recovered tool group: `Tool output`, `turnSucceeded=true`
  - Later assistant reply remains visible: `Recovered on the next autonomous turn.`
- Supporting earlier browser proof:
  - Public artifact: https://gist.github.com/qingminglong/37bd522a389e1f01668a62d251ef219c
  - This earlier artifact loaded the Control UI `/chat` route through the Vite app with the repo's deterministic mocked Gateway WebSocket. It is supporting browser/UI proof, not the primary stored-transcript proof.
- Focused local checks:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/chat/build-chat-items.test.ts`
  - `git diff --check`
  - `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local`
- Observed result:
  - `build-chat-items.test.ts`: 52 tests passed.
  - `git diff --check`: passed.
  - Autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings after the reviewer-flagged tool-call-only boundary risk was fixed and covered.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - The new proof reads a real stored transcript through OpenClaw's transcript reader/projection code and validates the Control UI grouping with Chromium, but it does not start a full production Gateway server or require live provider credentials.
  - A local PNG screenshot was generated by the proof script, but the public gist contains only HTML/JSON because GitHub gist upload does not accept binary PNG files through `gh gist create`.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/chat/grouped-render.test.ts` was attempted twice, but this Windows host's locale rendered the existing 12-hour timestamp test as `2026年1月16日 上午3:30` instead of an `AM|PM` string. 66/67 tests passed; the failing assertion is unrelated to this diff and is not in the touched code path.
